abi: cdecl void(const void *pixels); returned scratch EAX unused by both sprite dispatch callers.
algorithm: Read full framebuffer pointer, x, y and pitch. Compute wrapped32-bit destination, reload/cache pitch, then copy8 ordered DWORDs per row for16 rows from a contiguous512-byte source. Keep individual volatile DWORD loads/stores so overlapping inputs retain native semantics.
directed_domains: all overlap directions including same address
full-width coordinates and32-bit wrap with valid final mappings
caller_precondition: Source512 bytes and all destination32-byte rows must be mapped; clipping belongs to the callers.
